title: How AICR picks a recipe

scenes.heading: Same cluster. Different job.
scenes.sub: A team moves from training to serving
voice: A team used its EKS cluster for training. Now it wants to serve a model on the same H100 workers.

scenes.heading: Resolve the training target
voice: For the training target, set intent to training and platform to Kubeflow.
The recipe resolver combines that workload choice with the service, accelerator, and operating system criteria.

scenes.heading: Change what the cluster should run
voice: The inference run uses the same cluster criteria with inference intent and the NIM platform.
That selection produces a recipe with the NIM Operator for model-serving workloads.

scenes.heading: Inspect the difference
scenes.sub: Use the resolved recipe as the record
voice: Open the two outputs and compare their component lists, versions, and checks.
The two runs show exactly what AICR would configure for each workload on the same hardware.

payoff: Change the intent from training to inference and see a distinct resolved recipe for the same hardware.
